outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic workflow diagram illustrating the experimental pipeline; it does not present quantitative or replicated data, so replicate reporting is not applicable.

replicate_statements: Quantification of lactate concentration (pg/μm2) in SNL lung tissues; normal, LUADs and LUSCs (n = 7–11 regions per group from a total of 2 mice, biological replicates).
Ordinary one-way ANOVA with Dunnett’s multiple comparisons test was used for the statistical analysis, P = 0.0057.
outputs.replicate_type: biological replicates (n = 7–11 regions per group from a total of 2 mice)
outputs.explanation: The caption reports both the n-number (7–11 regions per group) and the replicate type (biological replicates, from a total of 2 mice), satisfying the reporting requirements for this quantified, statistically tested bar plot.

replicate_statements: Quantification of lactate concentration (pg/μm2) in the regions of low acidity (high pH) and high acidity (low pH), in the SNL lung tissues (n = 12–20 regions per group from a total of two mice, biological replicates).
Ordinary one-way ANOVA with Dunnett’s multiple comparisons test was used for the statistical analysis, P = 0.0013.
